mechanism: Zoledronic acid may increase infection risk through bone resorption inhibition while vedolizumab causes selective gut α4β7 integrin antagonism, potentially compromising mucosal immunity and increasing susceptibility to opportunistic infections.
action: Monitor for signs of infection during concurrent use; ensure appropriate vaccinations prior to vedolizumab initiation; consider timing and clinical necessity of bisphosphonate therapy in IBD patients on vedolizumab.
